findings.description: deliver() is now async, so `deliver(channel, message)` returns a coroutine object without running it. A coroutine object is always truthy, so the branch always runs `del lines[:sent]` and removes queued lines even though the digest was never sent. The coroutine is also never awaited, which raises a RuntimeWarning and means no retries happen. Any recipient's pending notifications are silently lost, and the failed list never reports them.
findings.suggestion: Make flush await the call: `if await deliver(channel, message):`.
